representation: A nine-bar null distribution of z, with a movable observed-statistic line, shaded right-tail bars for p, and a separately movable alpha decision line.
motion: the observed line moves with z
bar opacity changes so the tail follows the observed statistic
the alpha line moves independently with alpha
checkpoints: read the null distribution and observed statistic
see that the shaded tail is p
separate the alpha decision rule from p and from the probability the null is true
misconceptionTest: Alpha moves the dashed decision line but does not move the tail or the observed statistic; this separates a decision rule from p. The text says p is a tail area, not P(null true), and that a small p is not proof of the alternative. No causal claim is made.
accessibility: The z axis, observed line and alpha line are named in text, the tail is described as shaded bars, both sliders are keyboard accessible, and alt text gives the direction of the tail.
